Full job description
The Financial Systems & Reporting Analyst will be responsible for designing and developing simple to complex custom reports, dashboards, and scorecards in Workday and Adaptive. This role requires a highly analytical and detail-oriented professional with a deep understanding of Workday and Adaptive reporting. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in these financial systems, excellent problem-solving abilities, and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Partner with Finance, Accounting, Business Intelligence, Operations and other departments to understand business needs and translate them into technical reporting requirements
Design and develop simple to complex custom reports in Workday and Adaptive, including Advanced, Matrix and Composite reports, and Adaptive’s Office Connect
Build and maintain dynamic dashboards and scorecards using Workday Prism Analytics and Discovery Boards
Provide analysis on the impact of Workday updates and new releases on existing reports and recommend necessary changes
Provide ongoing support and troubleshoot issues for all existing custom reports, ensuring data accuracy and optimal performance
Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for all reports, including data dictionaries and metadata, to facilitate future maintenance and user understanding
Continuously improve financial processes and systems to enhance efficiency and accuracy

ROLE COMPETENCIES
Problem-Solving
Understands how Mission operates and how their role fits within the business
Champions innovative ideas for continuous improvement
Demonstrates the functional and technical knowledge needed for their role
Makes decisions by using a combination of analysis, experience and judgment, and an understanding of department and organizational impacts
Collaboration
Acts on individual responsibilities, objectives, and performance expectations in support of team goals
Leveraging individual skills and expertise to support the team in problem solving, decision making, and continuous improvement
Offers and seeks feedback on opportunities that will improve skills and efficiency for themselves and their teammates
Demonstrates a sense of commitment and support to direct teammates and the larger Mission team
Communication
Demonstrates consistent, effective communication with teammates, other departments and senior leadership, both written and verbal
Establishes rapport, and builds and maintains effective working relationships
Practices attentive and active listening, and asks questions or confirms expectations with department leaders
Proactive in requesting constructive feedback from supervisors
Continuous Improvement
Meets agreed upon individual and team goals and objectives
Understands how the team’s priorities align with company goals
Provides key information about their unique responsibilities in support of the formulation of strategies, tactics and deadlines
Continuously examines personal effectiveness and seeks to make improvements as needed

WAG VALUES
Leads with respect, integrity, and accountability.
Treats others with empathy and respect.
Exemplifies and leads the team to align with WAG values.
Collaborate with the team to focus on solutions.
Finds a way to say yes.

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or a related field
3-5 years of experience in financial reporting or a similar role, specifically using Workday and Adaptive
Proficiency in Workday Financials report development using Report Writer, Report Designer, and Calculated Fields
Strong understanding of Workday Adaptive Planning processes and best practices
Workday Financials certification is highly preferred
Experience with ERP and EPM system concepts
Proven ability to translate business requirements into functional report designs
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong attention to detail and accuracy
Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment


How You're Supported

As part of the Mission Pet Health family, you get the stability of a local practice backed by the comprehensive benefits and resources of a larger network. The focus is on investing in you, so you can focus on what you love.

Note: Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support you at every stage. Eligibility for specific benefits varies based on your role and hours worked.

Competitive Compensation
A competitive hourly rate or salary based on your experience and role.
Health & Wellbeing
We offer comprehensive coverage options including Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance, along with access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for all teammates.
Financial Security
Plan for your future with our 401k retirement options and additional financial protection benefits like Life Insurance and Disability coverage.
Commitment to Growth
We support your career goals with opportunities for professional development, including educational assistance for qualified teammates to enroll in AVMA-accredited veterinary technician programs.
The Power of a Network
Join a nationwide community of over 20,000 veterinary professionals who share a passion for collaboration, career growth, and sharing best practices.
Valuable Perks
Enjoy discounted veterinary care for your own pets, access to an online discount platform, and free 24/7 access to doctors through Teladoc.

About Mission Pet Health

Mission Pet Health was founded by veterinarians on the belief that local practices thrive with clinical autonomy, collaboration, and medical excellence. The organization provides world-class support to its 850+ hospital teams on a hyper-local basis so they can focus on what matters most: the medicine, their patients, and their team culture. Learn more at missionpethealth.com.

Driving the award-winning culture are the WAG values – Work Together, Amaze, and Grow. Mission Pet Health is veterinarian-led, people-focused, and on a mission to be the best place to work in veterinary medicine. We are proud to be recognized as a 2025 "Most Loved Workplace," ranked #2 in America's Top 100 and #1 in veterinary care.
